binary: zlib-wrapped DEFLATE standard (not raw deflate or gzip), base64 strict; exact original UTF8 JSON bytes reconstructed.

negotiation.client_fallback: If codec APIs unavailable or full envelope not smaller BEFORE send, send original JSON. Never fallback/retry after send uncertainty.

POST.inner: Original full body including account/request_id/iald_conv/messages and all task controls, exact bytes.
POST.scope: server account_key generation; compare outer+envelope+inner account; request_id/conversation must agree.
POST.before: Existing auth+origin/CSRF+body bound before decode; bounded decompress/hash/UTF8/strict JSON before ChatJobs.submit; no codec field passed into worker digest.

GET_page.page: Compress existing result response bytes, not whole answer/SSE; omit wrapper when <5percent or <1024B saving. Cache-Control private,no-store unchanged.

bounds.header_note: Prototype8MiB block limit is not used for chat envelope. Page bound covers one oversized first legacy event (current soft256000char page is not a hard bytes limit).

savings: Only envelope bytes <=raw_bytes-max(1024,ceil(raw_bytes*0.05)). Count full JSON wrapper and base64 metadata.
integrity: Check declared bytes before inflate, cap decoder output, require EOF of single deflate stream, no unused/trailing stream, exact UTF8 byte hash, reject duplicate JSON keys/nonfinite schema.
idempotency: Canonical restored body feeds unchanged ChatJobs.submit digest. No new request keys/cache/keys/accounts. Plain legacy request path unchanged.
failure: Explicit no_dispatch_this_submission before submit. Does not resolve or repeat any earlier uncertain job.
authentication: No new header/CORS permission; negotiation field/GET query only. Existing cookie/native bearer and CSRF/origin guard mandatory.
